::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Manesar-based product-engineering, ODM and electronics-manufacturing firm founded by Bhupender Saharan. Its silicon work is services for client chip companies (FPGA design, pre-silicon verification, post-silicon validation); no chip of its own is publicly documented.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Silicon-engineering services and ODM/EMS for networking, 5G, IoT and camera products; not an own-chip designer.
